description: Consolidation and deduplication test set, hand-labelled before any model saw it. Each pair is a memory already in the store and a new memory that vector search returned as its nearest neighbour. `relation` is how the new memory relates to the stored one, and it decides the action: same -> skip, refines -> update, contradicts -> supersede (mark the old one, keep it recoverable), complements -> link, unrelated -> insert.

relations.same: the new memory states the same fact as the stored one, only worded differently
relations.refines: the new memory states the same fact with more detail or a narrower scope, and does not conflict with it
relations.contradicts: the new memory says the stored one is no longer true, or cannot both be true with it
relations.complements: the new memory is a different fact about the same subject, and both stay true
relations.unrelated: the new memory is about a different subject, even if some words are shared
